open_problems.title: Perimeter-over-six for polyominoes with holes
open_problems.question: If a polyomino has total lattice perimeter ell, including hole boundaries, do max(1, floor(ell/6)) point guards always suffice?
open_problems.known: Massberg proves the hole-free theorem. The hole extension is identified as conditional on a maximal-rectangle packing conjecture.
non_implications: BiedlEtAl2012 is an area/cell-count theorem and does not imply a perimeter theorem.
progress_paths: Prove the ell/6 bound by another structural method.

open_problems.title: Massberg maximal-rectangle packing conjecture
open_problems.question: Does the maximal-rectangle packing structure needed for Massberg's method hold in rectilinear galleries with holes?
open_problems.known: Massberg's habilitation identifies this as the missing ingredient for extending the perimeter theorem to holes.
non_implications: The published DCG paper should be cited only for the hole-free theorem.
progress_paths: Find the precise obstruction and replace it with a different guard-count invariant.

open_problems.title: Integral orthogonal polygon perimeter bounds beyond the hole-free case
open_problems.question: Under the broader integral-domain reading, does floor(N/6) point guarding hold when holes or other lattice-domain conventions are allowed?
open_problems.known: The hole-free reading reduces to Massberg's hole-free polyomino theorem by unit-grid subdivision.
non_implications: The Diaz-Banez et al. ortho-unit theorem is stronger but only for unit-edge polygons.
The hole-free integral reading is not a separate open problem.
progress_paths: Resolve the holes version or reduce it to the polyomino-with-holes problem.

open_problems.title: Vertex guards for orthogonal polygons with holes
open_problems.question: Do the Shermer floor((n+h)/4) and Hoffmann floor(2n/7) style vertex-guard bounds hold for orthogonal polygons with holes?
open_problems.known: Zylinski proves the floor((n+h)/4) bound for h <= 2 and cactus-dual cases; Michael-Pinciu give improved h-independent bounds.
non_implications: These are vertex-count/vertex-guard questions, not point-guard perimeter questions.
progress_paths: Close the gap between conjectured bounds and h-independent upper bounds.
Classify quadrilateralization or diagonal-graph structures that force the conjectured color class.

open_problems.title: Urrutia-type edge-guard bounds for orthogonal polyhedra
open_problems.question: Can genus-zero orthogonal polyhedra with m edges be guarded with m/12 + O(1) closed edge guards?
open_problems.known: Benbernou et al. prove floor((e+r)/12) open edge guards and the derived (11/72)e and (7/12)r parameterized upper bounds, but these do not reach the conjectured m/12 + O(1) closed-edge target; Viglietta's thesis records the point-guard obstruction and edge-guard direction.
non_implications: 3D point-guard bounds are superlinear and are not the right analogue.
progress_paths: Improve edge-guard upper bounds for orthogonal polyhedra.
Find lower-bound constructions requiring a larger correction term.

open_problems.title: Reflex-edge guards in general orthogonal polyhedra
open_problems.question: Can the tight 2-reflex reflex-edge-guard behavior be extended to general 3-reflex orthogonal polyhedra?
open_problems.known: Viglietta proves strong results for 2-reflex orthogonal polyhedra; Benbernou et al. give edge-guard bounds parameterized by r and conjectural evidence around open reflex edges, but the general reflex-edge-only case remains open.
non_implications: The 2-reflex restriction is structural and should not be silently dropped.
A bound parameterized by the number of reflex edges does not imply that the guards are restricted to reflex edges.
progress_paths: Extend induction or charging methods beyond two reflex-edge directions.
Identify a counterexample to the direct generalization.

open_problems.title: General 3D polyhedron edge-guard gap
open_problems.question: How close can the best edge-guard upper bound for arbitrary polyhedra be brought to known lower-bound constructions?
open_problems.known: Cano, Toth, Urrutia, and Viglietta prove a (5/6)m edge-guard upper bound for arbitrary m-edge polyhedra and leave a substantial gap to known lower bounds.
non_implications: This is broader than the orthogonal-polyhedron m/12 + O(1) target, so it should not be cited as an orthogonal-specific theorem.
progress_paths: Separate the arbitrary-polyhedron and orthogonal-polyhedron gaps with sharper examples.

open_problems.title: Algorithmic restricted cases aligned with extremal bounds
open_problems.question: Which restricted orthogonal, polyomino, or polyhedral models admit exact polynomial algorithms or useful approximation guarantees for minimum guarding?
open_problems.known: General and many orthogonal variants are hard; several restricted visibility models have approximation or hardness results.
non_implications: Hardness of optimization does not rule out universal upper-bound theorems.
progress_paths: Find exact algorithms for natural subclasses.
Connect approximation algorithms to the structural decompositions used in extremal proofs.
